source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all thirteen Old Japantown rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: The Bodukkan
entities.source_summary: Former performing-arts center converted into the Kimen-Gumi's Old Japantown branch headquarters, with bunkrooms, offices, practice space, armories and detainee processing; no customer-facing commerce is stated.

entities.name: Crisis Medical Center
entities.source_summary: No-questions-asked medical center with advanced equipment, cyberpsycho containment, drug and cyberware trials, psychiatric and medical experiments, and nominal payments to volunteers.

services.label: Drug, cyberware and medical trial participation

entities.catalogue_note: Corporate product advertising inside the center does not establish a retail shelf, so no cyberware or pharmaceutical assortment is generated.

entities.name: Dine ‘n Dash
entities.source_summary: Mobile food cart attached to Media Hidori Shirakawa's motorcycle; customer interactions are livestreamed, and the mapped point is one of her most frequent stops.
entities.catalogue_note: The source confirms prepared food but does not specify a repeatable catalogue menu.

entities.name: Gazebo Park
entities.source_summary: Small neighborhood park and improvised playground with no source-supported commerce or service operation.

entities.name: The Grateful Crane
entities.source_summary: Kanezou Tsuruta's fortified guerrilla garden employs local workers, wholesales its best produce to restaurants in Watson and Kabuki, and lets Old Japantown residents pay 1eb per attempt to win damaged produce from crane machines.

local_offerings.label: Damaged fruit and vegetables offered as crane-machine prizes

entities.catalogue_note: The source defines site-grown produce rather than a generic food-store assortment.

entities.name: Kaifū Corner
entities.source_summary: Abandoned strip mall converted into the heavily trapped physical lair and client-access point of legendary Netrunner Recluse.

entities.name: Recluse
entities.source_summary: Legendary Netrunner who takes extremely expensive work; prospective clients must physically reach Kaifū Corner and jack into the lobby of her NET Architecture to negotiate.

entities.name: Kid Kamp
entities.source_summary: Fee-charging daytime childcare operation where children are fed and protected but also compelled to manufacture simple goods; the source presents the production as exploitative rather than a public shop.

entities.name: Kakoi-chō
entities.source_summary: Gated residential enclave of older families employing attendants, caregivers, drivers and cleaners; no public-facing commerce or named outlet is stated.

entities.name: The Precipice
entities.source_summary: Cargo-container residential community near Crisis Medical Center; residents may earn money as medical test subjects elsewhere, but the community itself has no source-supported commerce.

entities.name: Sanroo Complex
entities.source_summary: Sanroo Pacifica Confederation headquarters with offices, factory, shipping yard and warehouses; most Sanroo goods sold in Night City are manufactured locally, but no public retail outlet is stated in the complex.

entities.name: Segotari Factory
entities.source_summary: Segotari manufacturing facility producing inexpensive crane-game plush prizes and reportedly housing important Elflines Online servers; no public sales are described.

entities.name: Segotari Station Japantown
entities.source_summary: District recreation center and arcade where patrons play Elflines Online PVP tournaments plus dancing, fighting and racing games.

services.label: Dancing, fighting and racing arcade games

entities.name: Tartarus
entities.source_summary: Ruined former mall whose surviving tunnels serve as the Iron Sights' central stronghold; no source-supported public commerce remains at the site.
